unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation over a curated microsurgical literature corpus with direct citations to support clinical decision support
Automated evaluation of answer relevancy, faithfulness, G-Eval correctness and semantic similarity on 10 scenarios

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a new RAG system (MicroRAG) across 10 standardized clinical scenarios evaluating faithfulness, relevancy, and accuracy, but it does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
